Upstream: https://github.com/webdriverio/desktop-mobile
Published source: tauri-plugin-wdio-webdriver 1.5.0
Archive: https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/tauri-plugin-wdio-webdriver/1.5.0/download
The published .cargo_vcs_info.json records f5cf07da5ada8605b3bc779deac7ed5f49c469f0,
dirty: true, path_in_vcs: packages/tauri-plugin-webdriver. The crates.io archive,
not a claimed pristine checkout of that commit, is the original source here.
The upstream MIT license is retained unchanged in LICENSE.

Only src/platform/executor.rs differs from the published source:
- Map WebDriver U+E00E and U+E00F to PageUp/PageDown key, code and legacy keyCode.
- Send pointerdown/pointerup PointerEvents before the existing compatibility
  mousedown/mouseup events. Keep the existing single-click handling, pointer
  move, lifecycle, endpoints and other behavior unchanged.

This is a narrow primary-pointer input correction, not a claim of complete
native/trusted input or full Pointer Events default-action parity.
The Cargo patch is used only by the desktop's optional e2e feature.
Remove when upstream releases these fixes.
